events.headline: Houthis claimed missile/drone strikes on 'sensitive' targets in Riyadh (Sept 19-20); Saudi/Gulf stocks fell and Red Sea/Saudi oil-export risk resurfaced, keeping Middle East conflict escalation live

US Treasury's Bessent and China's Vice Premier He Lifeng opened talks on AI guardrails, tariffs and critical-minerals/rare-earth flows ahead of the Trump-Xi Washington summit; US to hold off new tariffs until after the summit
Fed raised its benchmark rate 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16 (first hike since 2023), aimed at combating oil-driven inflation; markets price one more hike this year

AI-driven chip demand remains extremely strong: TSMC equipment demand up ~90% with capacity expanded 5x this year, Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron sold out through 2027 on HBM deals, July worldwide chip sales up 135% y/y
